mentions.name: Betterleaks
mentions.description: A secret-scanning tool and successor to Gitleaks. Version 1.2.0 added GitHub as a source to scan for exposed secrets and introduced a new filtering system powered by CEL for more expressive filters.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on Betterleaks for the past three months. It's the successor to Gitleaks since I'm not focused on that project much anymore. I just released v1.2.0 which added GitHub as a source to scan for secrets against and a new filtering system powered by CEL for more expressiveness.
